plan_review.notes: Separate-model plan review (rubber-duck, gpt-5.5) before implementation. 1 blocking issue: the proposed ingester 'real completion' discriminator (bare hasStages) was too weak and could recreate the deadlock for a doc with an incidental object-valued stages field; resolved by requiring version===ISSUE_PIPELINE_CHECKPOINT_VERSION && typeof stages==='object' && stages!==null, imported via a new dependency-free issue-status-key.ts module to avoid a circular import. 4 non-blocking suggestions, all addressed: (1) tightened isLegacyIssueRunStatusShape to require a positive-integer issueNumber, non-empty fingerprint/stage, and a parseable updatedAt; (2) added identity-mismatch tests for both issueNumber and fingerprint; (3) added a test proving a legacy completed doc with a FRESH heartbeat still blocks reclaim (only stale legacy-completed docs reclaim); (4) documented the residual legacy-vs-malformed ambiguity tradeoff in a code comment on isLegacyIssueRunStatusShape. Reviewer endorsed the root-cause diagnosis and the fresh-reprocess-over-fake-success product choice; no publisher code change needed.
